scalars.scalar_value: Six months of custodial experience in commercial or public facilities

items.item_text: 01. The testing process will require access to a computer with a camera, microphone, speakers, and a reliable connection to the internet. If you do not have access to one or more of these components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations, please indicate so below. Options: I do NOT have access to one or more of the required components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations. | I have access to ALL of the required components and do not need alternate testing accommodations.

02. Do you possess at least six (6) months of full-time (or prorated part-time) experience performing custodial duties in a commercial or public facility? Your responses to this answer will be verified with the information you provide in the "Work Experience" section of your application. Options: Yes | No
03. Do you possess a current, valid California Driver License? Options: Yes | No

04. Which locations within VCCCD are you willing to work? (Check all that apply.) You will only be considered for vacancies at locations at which you indicate you are willing to work in response to this question. For Classified recruitments only: Please be aware that if you decline an interview and/or offer of employment three (3) times for one classification, you will be removed from the eligibility list for that classification. Options: Moorpark College | Oxnard College | Ventura College | District Administrative Center (located in Camarillo)

05. Please indicate the type of job (fulltime and/or part-time) AND the type of work (regular and/or temporary) that you are willing to accept. (Check all that apply). You will only be considered for vacancies with the type of job AND work that you are willing to accept. Options: Full-Time Job | Part-Time Job | Regular/Permanent Work | Temporary Work
Six months of custodial experience in commercial or public facilities

Sweep, mop, vacuum, scrub, and spot clean floors; strip, seal, wax, buff, and refinish hard surface floors; shampoo carpets and rugs. E Clean, wipe, dust, and polish desks, furniture, and woodwork; clean whiteboards. E Empty and clean waste and recycling receptacles; pick up paper and other debris; pick up trash containers and empty into large bins. E Clean and disinfect restrooms, locker rooms, child care center facilities, swim centers, food service areas, and health facilities including floors, walls, fixtures, appliances, and mirrors; restock supplies; polish metal fixtures. E Wash and clean accessible interior and exterior windows, ledges, and walls. E Pressure wash buildings and walkways; clean drinking fountains and grease traps; clean and refresh floor drains. E Move furniture and equipment; set up cafeteria, auditorium, gymnasium, meeting rooms, classrooms, and other areas for indoor and outdoor special events and meetings. E Perform minor non-technical repairs to buildings and fixtures; replace lights; clean and adjust blinds; adjust desks and other furniture; identify and report other repair and maintenance needs and assist others in making repairs. E Turn lights on and off; unlock and lock doors and gates; raise and lower flags. E Respond to urgent requests for immediate custodial assistance and other urgent safety and operational concerns. E Participate as part of a cleaning crew, as directed, for major cleaning assignments. E Provide information and assistance to students, faculty, staff, and the general public regarding locations of various campus facilities. E Operate a vehicle to perform assigned duties such as picking up and delivering supplies, equipment, and other materials as directed. E Attend safety and in-service training. E Work collaboratively and professionally with faculty, staff, students, and stakeholders from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, and ethnic communities. E Demonstrate cultural humility, sensitivity, and equity-mindedness in working with individuals from diverse communities; model inclusive behaviors; and achieve equity in assignment-related outcomes. E Perform other duties as assigned. E = essential duty
